heading.en: Life dates and early school posts

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥人名傳記辭典記載，克勞斯·伯恩森生於1844年6月12日，卒於1927年3月27日，身分是部長與民眾高等學校校長，出生地在菲因島的埃斯基爾斯特魯普。他青年時進入克里斯滕·科爾德在達爾比的高等學校與自由學校就讀。《大丹麥百科》記他1862年已出任霍爾比自由學校的校長，1881至1889年又擔任塞爾斯萊夫民眾高等學校的校長，其後遷往哥本哈根。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon records that Klaus Berntsen was born on 12 June 1844 and died on 27 March 1927, describing him as a minister and folk high school principal, born at Eskilstrup on Funen. As a young man he attended Christen Kold's high school and free school at Dalby. Lex (Den Store Danske) says he was already head of the free school at Højby in 1862 and principal of Særslev Folk High School in 1881–1889, after which he moved to Copenhagen.

citations.quote: Klaus Berntsen, 12.6.1844-27.3.1927, minister, højskoleforstander.
Født i Eskilstrup, Søllinge sg., Fyn
på Christen Kolds høj- og friskole i Dalby (1860-1861)
Allerede i 1862 blev Berntsen friskoleleder i Højby
1881-1889 var han forstander for Særslev Højskole
hvorefter han flyttede til København

body.zh-Hant: 《大丹麥百科》寫明，伯恩森1873至1884年與1886至1926年擔任民眾院議員，並與弗雷德·博伊森及其溫和派關係密切。丹麥人名傳記辭典則說，他在1873年5月的補選中當選博厄訥斯選區議員，1886年起連續四十年由阿森斯選區選出，直到1926年退出；又記他於1910至1922年出任丹麥射擊協會聯合會主席，1925年他成為1849年以來第一位擔任民眾院議員滿五十年的人，各黨在議會中向他致敬。
body.en: Lex says Berntsen was a member of the Folketing in 1873–1884 and 1886–1926 and was close to Frede Bojsen and his moderate group. The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon adds that he won the Bogense seat at a by-election in May 1873, was then returned for Assens for the next 40 years from 1886 until he withdrew in 1926, and chaired the Danish Rifle Associations in 1910–1922. It also records that in 1925 all parties honoured him in the Rigsdag on his 50th anniversary as a member.

citations.quote: Fra 1873-1884 og 1886-1926 var Berntsen medlem af Folketinget.
knyttet til Frede Bojsen og hans moderate gruppe
opnåede valg i Bogense-kredsen ved et omvalg i maj 1873
B. valgtes i denne kreds i de følgende 40 år, indtil han 1926 trak sig tilbage
1910–22 var han således formand for De danske Skytteforeninger
som den første siden 1849 kunne fejre 50-års jubilæum som folketingsmand
lod B. sig atter vælge til tinget 1886, denne gang i Assenskredsen
Det følgende år hyldedes B. fra alle partier i rigsdagen

body.zh-Hant: 《大丹麥百科》記載，伯恩森1908至1909年在內爾高與霍爾斯泰因－萊德堡兩屆內閣擔任內政大臣。丹麥人名傳記辭典補充說，內爾高內閣於1909年8月因國防法案而倒台；國王弗雷德里克八世在兩屆內閣離任後請他組閣，他婉拒，認為霍爾斯泰因－萊德堡伯爵更適合。
body.en: Lex records that Berntsen was interior minister in 1908–1909 in the Neergaard and Holstein-Ledreborg ministries. The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon adds that the Neergaard government fell in August 1909 over the defence bills, and that King Frederik VIII asked him to form a government but he declined, thinking Count Holstein-Ledreborg the right man.

citations.quote: I 1908-1909 var Berntsen indenrigsminister
Efter sin afgang som minister august 1909 da regeringen faldt på forsvarslovene
tilbød kongen B. at danne regering. Han afslog imidlertid tilbudet
grev Holstein-Ledreborg ville være den rette mand
indenrigsminister i ministerierne Neergaard og Holstein-Ledreborg
foreslog ham efter begge ministeriers afgang at danne regering
Frederik 8. værdsatte Berntsen og hans forsvarsinteresse

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥人名傳記辭典記載，伯恩森在1910年5月選舉後，於1910年7月1日組成各派自由黨人都參加的內閣，並親自兼任國防大臣。這屆內閣的主要任務之一是落實1909年的國防安排，真正的核心任務是修改上議院（Landsting）特權選舉權的憲法案。1913年春選舉後多數轉到激進黨與社會民主黨，他的內閣於1913年6月21日解散，由激進黨的扎勒政府接替；此後他仍主持憲法委員會，直到1915年憲法通過。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon records that after the May 1910 elections Berntsen formed on 1 July 1910 a ministry in which all groups of the Venstre were represented, and himself also took the Ministry of Defence. A main task was to carry out the 1909 defence arrangement, and the central task was the constitutional bill to change the privileged franchise for the Landsting. After the spring 1913 election the majority passed to the Radicals and Social Democrats; his ministry was dissolved on 21 June 1913 and gave way to the Radical Zahle government. He went on working for the constitution as committee chairman until its adoption in 1915.

citations.quote: dannede 1.7.1910 et ministerium hvori alle grupper af venstre var repræsenteret
Selv overtog han også forsvarsministeriet
var at føre forsvarsordningen af 1909 ud i livet
grundlovsforslaget der ændrede den privilegerede valgret til landstinget
B.s ministerium opløstes 21.6.1913 og gav plads for den radikale regering Zahle
indtil grundlovens endelige vedtagelse 1915
Først efter at valgene i maj 1910 havde givet de venstregrupper
samtidig med at flertallet gik over til radikale og socialdemokrater
som formand, først for folketingets udvalg derom og siden for fællesudvalget
Ved folketingsvalget foråret 1913 sejrede grundlovsforslaget imidlertid stort

heading.zh-Hant: 1920至1924年的國防大臣與不管部大臣
heading.en: Defence minister and minister without portfolio, 1920–1924

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥人名傳記辭典記載，1920年5月內爾高第二屆內閣成立時，伯恩森出任國防大臣，並在重病中推動了1922年有爭議的國防法。1922年10月因地主銀行事件改組，他把國防大臣一職讓給索倫·布羅森，但以不管部大臣身分留在內閣，直到1924年4月內閣總辭。《大丹麥百科》也記他1922至1924年在第三屆內爾高內閣擔任不管部大臣。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon records that in Niels Neergaard's second ministry in May 1920 Berntsen took the difficult post of defence minister and, despite serious illness, carried through the disputed defence laws of 1922. At a reshuffle in October 1922 after the Landmandsbank affair he gave up defence to Søren Brorsen but stayed in the government as minister without portfolio until the ministry resigned in April 1924. Lex also says he was minister without portfolio in 1922–1924 in the third Neergaard ministry.

citations.quote: I Niels Neergaards andet ministerium maj 1920 indtrådte B.
gennemførte trods alvorlig sygdom de omstridte forsvarslove af 1922
afgik B. som forsvarsminister til fordel for Søren Brorsen
minister uden portefølje indtil ministeriets afgang april 1924
I 1922-1924 var han minister uden portefølje i det tredje ministerium Neergaard.
Ved en rekonstruktion i oktober samme år som følge af Landmandsbankaffæren

people.name: José Luis Tejada Sorzano
people.nameZh: 何塞·路易斯·特哈達·索爾薩諾

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的權威檔把他記為何塞·路易斯·特哈達·索爾薩諾，生於1882年、卒於1938年，並把地區列為玻利維亞。Gale 出版的《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》由查爾斯·阿爾納德撰寫條目，記載他生於1882年1月12日，卒於1938年10月4日，是玻利維亞總統。條目稱他是執業律師，擅長銀行事務，也當過外交官。
body.en: The German National Library authority record names him José Luis Tejada Sorzano, born in 1882 and died in 1938, with Bolivia as his geographic area. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture (Gale), in an entry by Charles W. Arnade, gives his birth as 12 January 1882 and his death as 4 October 1938 and calls him president of Bolivia. It describes him as a lawyer by profession, an expert in banking, and a diplomat.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、財政部長與副總統
heading.en: Legislator, finance minister and vice president

body.zh-Hant: 百科全書條目寫明，特哈達·索爾薩諾在1914至1918年擔任議員，也曾在何塞·古鐵雷斯·格拉政府中出任財政部長。條目又說，他在1931年當選副總統，之後在總統丹尼爾·薩拉曼卡被迫辭職時接任總統。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry says Tejada Sorzano was a legislator from 1914 to 1918 and served as minister of finance in the government of José Gutiérrez Guerra. It adds that he was elected vice president in 1931 and assumed the presidency when President Daniel Salamanca was forced to resign.

citations.quote: He was a legislator from 1914 to 1918
minister of finance (Hacienda) during the government of José Gutiérrez Guerra
He was elected vice president in 1931
assumed the presidency when President Daniel Salamanca was forced to resign

body.zh-Hant: 百科全書條目記載，特哈達·索爾薩諾的總統任期是1934年11月27日至1936年5月17日。他任內最大的牽掛是與巴拉圭的查科戰爭，條目說當時確有為這個疲憊的國家尋求和平的真誠努力，但特哈達·索爾薩諾得到的支持很少，最後被心懷不滿的軍官推翻。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry gives his presidency as running from 27 November 1934 to 17 May 1936. His main preoccupation was the Chaco War with Paraguay; the entry says there were genuine attempts to secure peace for the beleaguered nation, but he had little support and was overthrown by frustrated military officers.
